user.title: Connect to your Autel charger
user.description: Enter the charger's local HTTPS address and web login PIN. Certificate verification is off by default for the charger's self-signed certificate. Setup only reads settings; it does not start or stop charging.

reconfigure.title: Change charger connection
reconfigure.description: Leave PIN Code blank to keep the saved PIN. The address must belong to the same charger.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to your charger again
reauth_confirm.description: The charger rejected the saved credentials. Enter its current web login PIN.

error.invalid_auth: The charger rejected the username or PIN.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the charger. Check its address, HTTPS access, and certificate setting.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname, optionally with an HTTPS port. Paths, credentials, and HTTP URLs are not supported.
error.invalid_response: The charger returned an unexpected or unsuccessful response.
error.unsupported_charger: This integration supports the verified single-connector AC MaxiCharger interface. This charger has a different connector layout or rating.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The address belongs to a different charger.

init.title: Polling settings
init.description:
Choose a polling preset. Medium checks for a vehicle every 20 s while unplugged, polls a connected vehicle every 20 s, and polls charging every 10 s. High refreshes faster; Low reduces traffic and keeps unplugged detection at 30 s. Custom exposes six intervals.

Intervals are waits after each refresh finishes, so response time adds to the effective delay. Saving reloads the integration without changing charger settings.

data_description.polling_preset: Medium is recommended. Unplugged telemetry and diagnostics refresh less often than connection checks. Existing numeric settings are retained as Custom; choose Medium to adopt the recommended schedule.
data_description.request_timeout: Maximum time to wait for each HTTPS request. Recommended: 15 s; normal telemetry can take 2-3 s. Increase if requests time out. This changes the allowed response time, not the polling rate.

custom.title: Custom polling intervals
custom.description:
Set intervals in seconds. Unplugged connection checks make one request; connected or charging status makes two. Additional readings add five. A connection change and accepted Home Assistant controls request immediate telemetry.

Intervals start after the previous refresh finishes. Slower responses lengthen the effective interval. Saving reloads the integration.

data.status_interval: Status while plugged in, not charging

data_description.unplugged_interval: Checks vehicle connection using realtime group 2560. Recommended: 20 s; 10-30 s balances detection delay and traffic. Reply time adds to the delay. Refresh can check sooner.
data_description.unplugged_status_interval: Reads status, power, current, voltage and session data using group 1537. Recommended: 120 s. A detected connection change also reads this immediately. Must be no shorter than vehicle detection.
data_description.unplugged_details_interval: Adds five reads for current limit, detailed meter/pilot data, Autostart, network signal and CPU/memory/flash. Recommended: 300 s. Must be at least as long as unplugged telemetry.
data_description.status_interval: Reads vehicle connection and telemetry while the car is plugged in but stopped, preparing, or otherwise not charging. Recommended: 20 s. Both Start and Stop are enabled when connected and not charging.
data_description.charging_interval: Reads vehicle connection and telemetry while charging. Recommended: 10 s; 5-15 s gives faster updates. Must be no longer than the plugged-in non-charging interval. Start is disabled while charging.
data_description.details_interval: Adds the five settings/measurement reads while plugged in, whether charging or stopped. Recommended: 120 s. Must be at least as long as plugged-in status. Current-limit and Autostart changes request immediate readback.

error.details_too_fast: Set plugged-in additional readings to the plugged-in status interval or longer.
error.charging_too_slow: Set charging refresh to the plugged-in status interval or shorter.
error.unplugged_status_too_fast: Set unplugged telemetry to the vehicle detection interval or longer.
error.unplugged_details_too_fast: Set unplugged additional readings to the unplugged telemetry interval or longer.
